propositions: Raw git mutations (add/commit/rm/reset/update-ref) that bypass canonical store write seams cause production bugs and must be statically detected by a two-layer deterministic CI lint (Python AST + workflow/shell cwd-aware scanning).

Layer P (Python) detects raw subprocess invocation with git mutation verbs resolved by local intra-function tracking (list literals, local variables with splat, or opaque argv), and wrapper-name calls (run_git/run_git_write/_run_git/_git) passing mutation verbs via the same tracking, fail-closed for unresolvable argv.

Layer W (workflows/shell) detects git mutation verbs only when the same step/script establishes tracker context (cd into .tickets-tracker, git -C tracker-path, or working-directory naming it), preventing false positives on non-tracker commits.
Sanction is a single mandatory inline marker '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' on the line or enclosing function; marker-without-reason fails the lint; no external allowlist.

The authoritative inventory of seam-internal hits (gitutil/event_append/txn/purge_bridge/git_adapter/_ref_lock), per-module _git maintenance callers, and disposable-workspace sites is produced by report-mode bootstrap and fully dispositioned via markers or remediation before enforcement mode activation.

Teaching message directs authors to store write APIs (event-append/transaction/reconciler seams); accepted residual limitations are cross-function argv construction and dynamically computed tracker-targeting variables, documented in lint header.
